name: rokan-terminal
description: Local bridge for Rokan Terminal: node-pty + ws + Cloudflare quick tunnel + pairing token. Nothing here executes on an agent's behalf; every keystroke comes from the human's browser tab.

scripts.check: test -s bin/rokan-terminal.js && node --check bin/rokan-terminal.js && node --check src/bridge.js && node --check src/protocol.js && node --check src/ledger.js && node --check src/shell-integration.js && node --check src/mcp.js && node --check src/mcp-resources.js && node --check src/rokan-trailer.js
